properties.notes: Allocated site. The redevelopment of Roxeth Library presents an exciting opportunity to create a transformative and inclusive facility for the local community, alongside new housing for the people of Harrow. It presents a chance to establish a distinctive sense of place for the library on the high street with a generous and high quality public setting that encourages social interaction and boosts the perception of the local high street and South Harrow Town Centre.
